hathajodi.species: Indian Monitor Lizard (Hemipenis sold as sacred root)
hathajodi.meaning_desc: Dried monitor lizard hemipenis fraudulently marketed as a holy root (Hatha Jodi) for wealth and tantric rituals.

khurpa.meaning_desc: Slang for pangolin scales resembling a small agricultural trowel (khurpa).

chhilka.meaning_desc: Codeword literally meaning 'peels' or 'husk', referring to detached keratin scales.

safed sona.meaning_desc: Literally 'white gold', clandestine marketplace term for elephant tusks and ivory carvings.

kasturi.meaning_desc: Glandular secretion pods harvested from male musk deer for perfumery and traditional medicine.

shahtoosh.meaning_desc: Literally 'king of fine wools', made from the fleece of slaughtered wild chiru antelopes.

siyar singhi.species: Golden Jackal (Skull horn growth / skin charm)
siyar singhi.meaning_desc: Deceptive tantric charm made from jackal skull bone and tuft of hair sold to ward off evil.

billi ka nal.species: Jungle Cat / Wild Cat (Umbilical cord / placenta)
billi ka nal.meaning_desc: Dried wild cat umbilical cord marketed as an auspicious charm for childbirth and prosperity.

rakta chandan.meaning_desc: Endemic precious hardwood targeted for massive illegal logging and smuggling across international borders.

tara kachhua.meaning_desc: Targeted heavily for exotic pet syndicates and feng-shui beliefs in Southeast Asia.

sher nakh.meaning_desc: Tiger claws and canines encased in gold amulets or charms.

kadalu kukke.meaning_desc: Marine invertebrate harvested illegally in Gulf of Mannar for dried trepang export.
